title: Zesty Japanese Pickle Noodles
description: A refreshing and energizing Japanese dish featuring nuka-pickle and green cardamom pods, served on a salt block. This Buddhist-temple-friendly meal is perfect for a light lunch.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the soba noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the rice vinegar, mustard paste, and salt.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and add the crushed green cardamom pods.
Add the chopped nuka-pickle to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked soba noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the nuka-pickle mixture.
Stir in the rice vinegar mixture and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Divide the noodle mixture among individual salt blocks.
Garnish with thinly sliced scallions and serve immediately.
Serve with additional rice vinegar and mustard paste on the side, if desired.
